gloss: to compensate for; to supplement; to make up for

definitions.gloss: to compensate for; to make up for
definitions.explanation: To offset or counterbalance a deficiency or loss.
To add what is lacking or needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補|おぎな}う。
⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{補|おぎな}った。
examples.english: I made up for my lack of experience with hard work.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{欠点|けってん}→欠点：02702_ketten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補|おぎな}い⟦{合|あ}う→合う：09500_au⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧。
examples.english: A relationship where we compensate for each other's weaknesses.

examples.japanese: {保険|ほけん}で{損失|そんしつ}を{補|おぎな}った。
examples.english: The loss was compensated for by insurance.

examples.japanese: {水分|すいぶん}を{補|おぎな}うために{水|みず}をたくさん{飲|の}んだ。
examples.english: I drank a lot of water to replenish my fluids.

examples.japanese: {人手|ひとで}が{足|た}りないので、アルバイトで{補|おぎな}う。
examples.english: We are short-staffed, so we will supplement with part-time workers.

notes:
{補|おぎな}う is transitive ({他動詞|たどうし}). It takes を for what is being supplemented or made up for.

ASPECT ({ている}):
{補|おぎな}っている indicates ongoing compensation or supplementation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {栄養|えいよう}を{補|おぎな}う (to supplement nutrition)
- {不足|ふそく}を{補|おぎな}う (to make up for a shortage)
- {欠点|けってん}を{補|おぎな}う (to compensate for weaknesses)
- {補|おぎな}い{合|あ}う (to complement each other)

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- ～を{補|おぎな}う: What is being supplemented/compensated
- ～で{補|おぎな}う: What is used to compensate

RELATED WORDS:
- {補足|ほそく}: Supplement, addition
- {補充|ほじゅう}: Replenishment
- {補償|ほしょう}: Compensation (financial)

forms.negative: {補|おぎな}っていませんでした
